rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being personally confident that something is true.

example.jyutping: ngo5 hang2 ding6 keoi5 gam1 jat6 wui5 dou3

rows.note: Use this when a fact, result, or conclusion has been established rather than merely believed.

example.english: It is now certain that the flight is delayed.
example.traditional: 而家已經確定班機延遲。
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 kok3 ding6 baan1 gei1 jin4 ci4

rows.note: Use this for something fixed or recurring at set times, such as intervals or schedules.

example.english: We meet at a certain fixed time every Friday.
example.traditional: 我哋每個星期五都有固定時間開會。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 mui5 go3 sing1 kei4 ng5 dou1 jau5 gu3 ding6 si4 gaan3 hoi1 wui6

rows.note: Use this in formal or written contexts for an outcome that is inevitable.

example.english: As long as the direction is right, success is certain to be yours.
example.traditional: 只要方向正確，成功必然屬於你。
example.jyutping: zi2 jiu3 fong1 hoeng3 zing3 kok3 sing4 gung1 bit1 jin4 suk6 jyu1 nei5
